records.prompt:
STRICT VERTICAL TOP-DOWN ORTHOGRAPHIC modeling SITE PLAN. Camera at zenith looking straight DOWN, no perspective tilt, no cliff sides or vertical facades. ONE high-quality stylized 3D terrain image on PALE NEUTRAL GREY background with whole footprint and12%margin. Image1 is the NEW CLOSED technical road plan: it OVERRIDES the old road in image2. Image2 is the SAME WORLD draft, preserve its biome, land shape, quality and material character while replacing its open road with the NEW winding closed route and adding the specified buildings. Tree crowns/roofs seen from above, no trunks or cliffs. Ignore schematic symbols/colors/dots. Render beautiful readable terrain materials and architecture, not flat diagram.
Physical route MUST follow the NEW closed guide: a long SERPENTINE CIRCUIT passing through the INTERIOR with many alternating smooth bends, then a return corridor JOINING the start tangentially. One continuous repeatable road, NO DEAD ENDS and NO ordinary round perimeter racetrack. Keep the winding interior parts dominant. No same-level intersections, shortcuts, disconnected segments or sharp junction. Reserve generous clear shoulders on both sides for later musical tiles. No labels, marker dots, arrows, compass, UI, characters or glowing tile chain.
TRIPO GEOMETRY: OPEN RAVINES and visible cuttings. NO enclosed caves or long tunnels, no dark tunnel mouth. Only a very SHORT thick natural stone ARCH like a small stone bridge, open to daylight on BOTH sides, with clearly visible road continuing through; roof length no more than road width. Broad flat bridge decks with smooth bank connections. No stairs, house entrances, machines or vegetation across the road.
Add the specified courier-world buildings OUTSIDE road shoulders on broad raised pads. Rounded functional doors, chunky brass/copper radio vents, short sturdy antennas and visible simple mechanisms match the courier characters. Buildings use each world's OWN materials/palette; do not recolor all worlds cream/mint. Keep main terrain silhouette, biome landmarks and distinct colors from draft. Avoid huge central tower surrounded by a circle. Few large readable structures and coherent landscape, not tiny crowded scatter.

WORLD: Коралловый оазис
PALETTE: Coral pink and terracotta sandstone, apricot sand, vivid turquoise water, dusty teal palms and faded red adobe. No white stone castle.
TERRAIN: Broad stepped red-sandstone mesas joined by thick low natural saddles, an asymmetrical many-sided desert landmass with flat tall buttes and a bowl-like oasis depression.
LANDSCAPE: A small off-center flat-roof adobe settlement, one turquoise pond with chunky palms, a thick eroded sandstone gate and sculptural wind-carved rock fins. Keep generous areas of open sand.
COURIER ARCHITECTURE: A group of two stepped coral-adobe radio homes EAST of the oasis, flat red roofs with thick brass vent stacks and short aerials; a squat eroded sandstone signal/watch tower on the WEST butte with a copper ring receiver. Rounded doors/speaker vents and brass mechanisms connect to the courier world. Desert materials, no ivory village.
ROAD MATERIAL: Broad compacted rose-sand road with embedded rust-colored slabs, low dune shoulders, no continuous circular curb.
ART DIRECTION: Chunky sun-baked terracotta forms and stylized layered erosion, large uncluttered warm surfaces.
Exactly ONE top view; no collage or extra panels.
CLOSURE PRIORITY: Old Image2 has capped NW and NE road ends; DELETE BOTH CAPS. NEW Image1 connects them with a gently winding NORTH return corridor above the northern mesa, making one long CLOSED continuous circuit with dominant deep INTERIOR bends around the oasis and western rock fins. ZERO endpoints or T junction. Add two stepped coral-adobe radio homes EAST of oasis with chunky brass vent stacks and short aerials, plus squat sandstone copper-ring signal tower WEST butte. Off-road pads, preserve broad shoulders. Exact guide closed-road geometry overrides all draft road.

qa.palette_world: pass: terracotta/coral sandstone, rose-sand road, turquoise oasis, dusty teal palms.
qa.road: PASS: single visibly closed winding circuit with northern return and deep interior oasis bend, no capped ends or junction. Northern return curves below rather than above tallest mesa versus technical guide.
qa.architecture: Two stepped coral-adobe radio homes EAST of oasis with brass tanks/short aerials; squat WEST signal tower with copper ring receiver, offroad.
qa.geometry: Open sandstone terrain and short daylight arch; no long tunnel.
qa.camera: High overhead but clearly oblique, facades/butte faces visible; not strict nadir.
qa.framing: Complete island and neutral pale margin.
qa.inventory: Oasis/palms, eroded gate, rock fins/buttes coherent; old adobe settlement simplified to exact two homes.
